comparisonSelection.policy: Renderer benchmarks require a declared SVG, raster, PDF or terminal output. Validator, parser, formatter and conversion-only tools, applications and explicit catalog-only entries remain discovery records. The descendant override cannot enable them. Descendants without established distinct branding are excluded from normal comparisons, even with code changes. Owner/package scopes and runtime suffixes alone do not establish branding. Bindings and zero-ahead versions are also excluded. An explicit inclusion override retains these for version/runtime investigations. Selection guidance uses the recorded catalog snapshot, not a fresh upstream audit. Ports and changed forks remain separate. Zero-ahead descendants can be omitted from a current-engine comparison, but historical/build studies retain them. Measurement aliases require verified artifact, build, runtime and invocation equivalence through catalog-eligibility; lineage alone never supplies a score.
